display_title: HORIZON-MISS-2027-04-CIT-01 Innovative microgrids for improved energy system integration and efficiency in urban contexts – Horizon Europe
call_title: Supporting the implementation of the Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities Mission (HORIZON-MISS-2027-04)
call_module_title: HORIZON-MISS-2027-04-CIT-01 Innovative microgrids for improved energy system integration and efficiency in urban contexts
executive_summary: Demonstrates low-voltage direct-current microgrids in European urban buildings or neighbourhoods, testing flexibility, efficiency, regulatory feasibility and digital-twin replication. Each proposal needs three city beneficiaries in different eligible countries, including a selected Cities Mission city. The topic budget is EUR 20 million, with around EUR 7 million expected per project. Opening 2027-02-09. Full proposal deadline 2027-10-07 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Missions Work Programme, pp. 157–160, describes the eligible work in Scope. A Dutch TSO can be an additional funded beneficiary for system-level flexibility assessment, modelling or standardisation. The three eligible city beneficiaries and the mandatory Mission city remain separate consortium requirements. This supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are date-helper defaults based on 1 January 2027 and 36 months.
